Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E2E_ E_ INPUTERR_ NULL E2E_ E_ INPUTERR_ WRONG E2E_ E_ INTERR E2E_ E_ OK For definitions for return values, see SWS_ E2E_00047. This function is intended for usage at the data source (i.e., in case of C/ S communication at the cli ent). Available via E2E.h
